topicName: What are the main components of the JPA architecture?
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"What are the main components of the JPA architecture?"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"The Java Persistence API (JPA) architecture defines a standard way to map Java objects to relational database tables and manage persistence. Key components include the EntityManager, EntityManagerFactory, Persistence Unit, and JPA provider."}]
